blocks.text: Roku Voice Remote Pro (2nd edition) is the ultimate Roku remote. Enjoy convenient USB-C charging with 50% more battery life that lasts three months on a single charge. Easy-to-see backlit buttons make movie night navigation a breeze. And using your voice to search and control your streaming is as simple as saying, “Hey Roku.” There’s even a voice-activated lost remote finder for when it plays hard to get. Roku Voice Remote Pro (2nd edition) works with most Roku players and all Roku TV models. *Some older models may not be supported

items.label: Stay powered for months
items.value: Keep your remote running for three months on a single charge. With 50% more battery life and USB-C charging, Roku Voice Remote Pro (2nd Edition) is the ultimate TV companion.

items.label: Built for movie nights
items.value: No more fumbling in the dark to find the pause button or turn up the volume. Always know what you’re about to press with easy-to-see backlit buttons.

items.label: Just talk to it
items.value: Got popcorn fingers? Leave the remote in the other room? Just say “Hey Roku” from across the couch and control your streaming with your voice.

items.label: Find your lost remote
items.value: Don't break a sweat tearing apart the couch. Just say “Hey Roku, where’s my remote?” or find it using the free Roku Mobile app.

items.label: One that does it all
items.value: No more juggling remotes. Roku Voice Remote Pro (2nd Edition) powers up your TV, adjusts the volume, and controls your Roku device.

items.label: Live TV in a click
items.value: Start watching free live TV and local news with just one press.

items.label: Do more with your voice
items.value: Quickly search across thousands of apps, play entertainment, control your streaming, and more with voice commands.

items.label: Save your faves
items.value: Set shortcuts to open any app, turn on closed captions, search entertainment, and more with the quick launch button.

items.label: Very compatible
items.value: Our ultimate remote is designed to work with any Roku TV model.
